main.description: Ask the AppView to index one record from the caller's own repo, for an interaction no relay delivered. The AppView fetches the record from the caller's PDS; it never writes to any repository. Requires auth.

uri.description: AT-URI of a record in the caller's repo.

status.description: Outcome. 'unchanged' means a newer or identical version was already indexed.

caughtUp.description: True when the AppView has applied the caller's repository up to the revision it fetched for this record. Then every private read sees the record's state, and the caller's other private posts stay readable, until the caller's repository moves again, except under the caller's `following` audiences: those are read again once the firehose has applied the caller's commit, usually within seconds. To get there, the AppView lists the caller's blocks, private blocks, audiences and private posts, for a member or private owner that is ready. False means the record arrives the usual way, through the firehose, usually within seconds. A repository with more than about 800 blocks, private blocks, audiences and private posts together gets false on every call. For an owner of a `following` audience, its follows count toward the same limit. A record that cannot be written makes the caller's account not ready until it is set up again, as on the firehose. A second call by the same account within 10 seconds does not list the repository and answers caughtUp as it stands, usually false.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is not in the caller's repo, or its collection is not supported.
